inquiry: Hi, we're 4 friends looking to visit Skardu for about 8 days in late April. Budget is around $900 each. We'd really love to see the Deosai plains - we've seen photos and they look incredible. We're all reasonably fit. Two of us are British, two Australian.
notes: The deliberately hard case. Deosai is snowbound until mid-June, so the requested trip cannot be sold as asked. A correct answer substitutes another valley and says why. A confident wrong answer routes through the plains anyway.
